name: Huizenga

name: Magaziner

name: Subramanyam

name: Bacon
reading: CNBC's interview of Nov 11, in which he says Huang should resign, and two other outlets' articles of Nov 12 that report it.

name: Blumenthal
reading: His words to Semafor on a Senate investigation (Nov 9); CNBC's article of Nov 9, which says he renewed "on Thursday" his warning to donors to the president's ballroom, Nvidia among them; a blog's commentary on that demand (Nov 9).

name: Warner
reading: His words to Semafor (Nov 9); a report carried by VINnews that he "said Monday" he is interested in investigating further (Nov 10); and a Bloomberg report carried by the Straits Times that quotes him after the briefing of Nov 9. That third report was saved on Nov 16, after the eighth reading: until then it was known here only from a reader's comment under a blog post, which is the fourth page; the blog's own article does not name him.

name: Neal
reading: The letter of Nov 12 with Sen. Wyden, reported by CNBC, the Wall Street Journal and the Financial Times (three separate reports).

name: Scott
reading: His letters of Nov 12 are reported by the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal and the Washington Examiner (three separate reports). The Times's stand-alone article and the entry in its live page are one report, so the four articles are three. On Nov 15 he was withdrawn on the first two; the Examiner's article, which the aggregators listed on Nov 12 and which was not among the saved pages, was saved on Nov 16. A fifth piece listed that day, Politico's, names him in its headline and could not be saved.

name: Changpeng Zhao
reading: His post of Nov 12 is quoted in four outlets' articles (four separate reports).

name: Ron Conway
reading: His post of Nov 11 is reported in two different articles of the San Francisco Standard (a news report and a round-up of reactions) and quoted by the Washington Post.
